title: Wellman Braud, his sweepstake win, and the record date with Edmund Hall
summary: Vincent describes bassist Wellman Braud, who won a large sweepstake and opened a restaurant, and the recording session where Braud could not return and George Foster played bass.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique
